question.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ 5\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
question.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have  

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 0 \\ 5\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ {x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-{x}_{2} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2{x}_{3} \\ 0 \\ 5{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+5{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}=2 \\ {x}_{2}=3 \\ {x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+5{x}_{3}=-1\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 1 & 1 & 5 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 1 & 1 & 5 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 2 & 3 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-2{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}=2 \\ {x}_{2}=3 \\ {x}_{3}=-3.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=-3$ and from the second equation we get ${x}_{2}=3.$ Substituting these into the first equation, we obtain

$$
{x}_{1}-3+2(-3)=2\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=11.
$$

So, the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=11$, ${x}_{2}=3$, and ${x}_{3}=-3,$ which means 

$$
11{a}_{1}+3{a}_{2}-3{a}_{3}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=11+3-3=11.
$$
